message.content:
London’s official time zone is **Europe/London**.  
* In standard time (roughly late October – late March) it follows **Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)**, which is **UTC + 0**.  
* During daylight‑saving time (late March – late October) it switches to **British Summer Time (BST)**, which is **UTC + 1**.  

So depending on the time of year, London is either UTC + 0 or UTC + 1.
